#### Work This Example Yourself {#sec-ppc-526}

NIST's original page for this section offers a Dataplot-driven, click-through walkthrough of the case study, running each analysis step interactively in Dataplot. Since this book reproduces the entire analysis directly in executable R throughout the preceding sections, working the example yourself is a matter of re-running the R code shown in each subsection with the [downloaded data](../../datasets/MACHINE.DAT), rather than stepping through a separate macro-driven tool:

1. [Read the data](#sec-ppc-521-data) and reproduce the [box plots by machine, day, time of day, and sample](#sec-ppc-522-initial-steps).
2. Reproduce the [analysis of variance with all factors and with machine only](#sec-ppc-523-anova-all), including the [4-plot residual diagnostics](#sec-ppc-523-model-validation).
3. Reproduce the [throughput graph and analysis of variance](#sec-ppc-524-summary).

Each step's code chunk in this book is self-contained and can be copied into an R session (with the `tidyverse` and `patchwork` packages loaded) to reproduce that step's output directly.
